name: Power Supply Brackets for K8200 printer

captions.detailed: This 3D-printable model is a mounting bracket featuring a large rectangular collar and two parallel mounting arms extending from one side. The rectangular collar is designed to slide over a structural profile or power supply, while the two arms contain hexagonal recessed holes to accommodate mounting bolts and nuts. The inner faces of the bracket assembly feature stepped ridges and alignment tabs to ensure a secure, keyed fit against the mating surface.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric mounting bracket with a rectangular sleeve on one side and a dual-prong mounting fork on the other. Include parameters for the sleeve dimensions, wall thickness, prong spacing, and hexagonal bolt/nut recesses on the prongs for easy hardware mounting.
captions.factory: The script defines a rectangular collar using a difference of two cubes. A translation offsets the mounting fork, which is constructed by unioning two flat arms (cubes) with cylindrical end caps ($fn=4) and stepped alignment ridges. Hexagonal mounting holes are subtracted from the arms using rotated cylinders with six-sided resolution ($fn=6), creating both a pass-through bolt hole and a larger hexagonal counterbore for nuts.
